definition.name: purification
definition.definition: A purification of a mixed state rho on C^d is a pure state |rho_bar> in C^d tensor C^r (for some r >= rank(rho)) such that tr_2(|rho_bar><rho_bar|) = rho, where tr_2 denotes partial trace over the second (ancilla) register. Purifications are not unique: if |rho_bar> is a purification, so is (I_d tensor U)|rho_bar> for any unitary U on C^r. A 'random purification' is obtained by applying a Haar-random unitary to the ancilla register of a fixed purification.
